judgment: PASS for the recorded model/tokenizer/dataset/tool/training/evaluation engineering boundaries and small CPU correctness probes. This is not a capability, heldout accuracy, full-corpus provenance, GPU readiness or new inference-CLI verdict.

finding_history.problem: Vision keyword scoring accepted an output listing every class/direction, and negated or interrogative class claims.
finding_history.counterexample: Seven real validation records all gave semantic=true for 左、右、上、下、褲子、包、短靴。; negated/query class answers were also accepted by the original keyword rule.
finding_history.verification: Conservative full positive-answer match now rejects the universal, negated, uncertain and interrogative answers; exact positive target still passes.

finding_history.problem: Non-tool cases could execute a calculator unnecessarily and still receive semantic success.
finding_history.counterexample: A real tool_missing validation prompt ran add(1,1), received real tool result, then a fixture generator emitted the reference clarification; the old scorer returned semantic=true despite expected_tool=false.
finding_history.verification: Missing-parameter and OCR cases both reject unnecessary tool calls; the latter recheck covers a task-specific semantic overwrite.

finding_history.problem: Tool final-answer scoring accepted a negation or contradictory answer if its last integer happened to equal the executor result.
finding_history.counterexample: Real bounded add(1,2) returns 3; 結果不是3。, 0才對，不是3。, 結果可能是3。 and 結果是3嗎？ each passed the old roundtrip scorer.
finding_history.verification: Full finite positive numeric grammar rejects all four plus 結果是0，3。; 結果是3。 still passes after the actual call/executor chain.

finding_history.problem: The tool-loop message copy discarded legitimate message-level image/audio metadata.
finding_history.counterexample: Move a real validation image/layout into its user message: direct RecordEncoder has image payload, but the old tool-loop generator callback has no modality. Current distributed data uses top-level assets, so this was an interface defect rather than a demonstrated current-corpus leak.
finding_history.verification: Public metadata survives the same callback path; supervision and unknown metadata are still excluded.

finding_history.problem: Explicit empty history fell back to the full record including its gold assistant target.
finding_history.counterexample: encode(real_vision_record,generation=True,messages=[]) produced a prompt containing 這是褲子。; normal evaluate main did not invoke this empty-history boundary.
finding_history.verification: Explicit empty nonmodal history yields only BOS and assistant role; missing required multimodal attachment fails rather than adding gold history.

finding_history.problem: Initial voice data lacked the specified audio answer followed by typed topic/format continuation.

initial_source.note: Observed before producer mutation: 45 one/two/switch rows; switch changed format before audio. The initial data fingerprint was not retained, so no same-version claim is made for that old file.

finding_history.counterexample: Initial switch history was two-point instruction, format confirmation, 改成一句, confirmation, then audio; it did not test retaining an already answered audio topic.
finding_history.verification: Real current validation line 4 has the continuation contract. Actual main with explicit generated-token sentinels uses first generated answer in the second prompt, excludes demonstrated gold answer, uses the same model instance, and independently regenerates both zero-audio turns.

finding_history.problem: Final generated-reply metrics were aggregated only by task rather than the required intent/class/relation/OCR conditions.
finding_history.counterexample: An aggregate of 18 correct replies in two intents and two wrong replies in a third is 90%, while the third intent is 0%; a task-only aggregate cannot demonstrate an 80% per-intent criterion.
finding_history.verification: Final reply strata explicitly include intent, format/history variant, queried vision class/axis/position, OCR case/font/condition and source-group denominators; perception metrics remain separate.

finding_history.problem: Message-level assets bypassed zero-modality controls and asset counts.
finding_history.counterexample: A legitimate user-message image has no record.image; the old top-level-only condition skipped its zero control and reported zero image assets.
finding_history.verification: Actual main with a real message-level validation image emits zero_output and reports one image asset.

finding_history.problem: Initializing a new stage from any checkpoint unconditionally claimed validation selection.
finding_history.counterexample: --init-checkpoint latest.pt loads the latest model, which may differ from selected best, but history previously always said selection=validation_loss.
finding_history.verification: Checkpoint kind, loaded file SHA and step are recorded; only selected_validation_best gets the validation-selection label, otherwise explicit_init_checkpoint.

finding_history.problem: A global record task misrouted earlier images in a mixed vision/OCR history.
finding_history.counterexample: A public vision-image user message followed by public OCR ROI: task=ocr raises missing ROI on the prior vision image; task=vision_relation silently produces [image,image].
finding_history.verification: Both task tags now produce [image,ocr], with kind chosen from each image ROI; a missing ROI on the current OCR attachment is rejected.

finding_history.problem: A hard crash after complete raw-row fsync but before receipt update could cause silent regeneration of that complete row.
finding_history.counterexample: With two complete raw JSONL rows and a valid receipt committing only the first, the old journal loaded one row and would regenerate TEST_SECOND.
finding_history.verification: Current actual main preserves both raw rows byte-for-byte, recovers one complete tail row, generates zero additional replies, and rejects a duplicate/invalid complete tail. Incomplete non-newline tail remains in the original artifact and is disclosed separately.

passed_checks: Inference tensor inputs are ordered text and actual pixels/audio features plus public ROI/layout/index; supervision/source transcripts/IDs are not fed to the neural model. Changing noninput labels/provenance left sampled IDs and modality tensors unchanged.

Model-generated JSON drives the true bounded whitelist calculator, tool-role insertion and another generation by the same model; the runtime does not return full assistant answers. Explicit fake callbacks were used only for protocol boundary probes and are not neural capability evidence.
Current vision/tool scorers reject universal, negated, uncertain and interrogative false positives; unnecessary calls are separately reported and fail non-tool semantic rubrics, including OCR.
The actual voice continuation main path uses generated first reply, never demonstrated first gold answer, in the second prompt; controls have their own first generation and the same model instance.
OCR has 13 CTC symbols: blank=0 and 12 glyphs=1..12; repeated glyphs separated by blank decode correctly. Real sample crops/audio/vision have finite random-neural forwards and two-token generations.
Three latest-source tiny CPU SFT steps versus one plus resume to three match model, optimizer, sampler, RNG and selected-best tensors exactly, with 345 input tokens and maximum parameter delta 0.
Validation alone selects best; checkpoint data/assets/tokenizer/preprocess are checked. Resume/checkpoint kind and explicit stage initialization provenance are honest.

Frozen final-test journal verifies identical protocol/checkpoint/code/data/asset/generation conditions and saved raw prefix. Completed rows are preserved and skipped, complete fsync tail rows are reconciled, completed final test retries and mismatched/tampered recovery are rejected.

Total neural parameter accounting includes language and all perception/router/projection weights. MoE total and selected-expert active-language counts are distinguished, and Dense comparison explicitly does not match total parameters/FLOPs/memory. Tiny independent counts matched actual unique tensors.
scope_limits: No paid job, GPU test, model release or real frozen test was performed by this reviewer. CPU stage steps are engineering fixtures, not main training or capability validation.

Reviewed all eight named source/spec files and sampled real train/validation records and three actual modality assets. Raw test targets/transcripts were not examined. Test JSONL bytes were hashed only.

Manifest split policies and sample public/label boundaries were reviewed; exhaustive original-image/string/template/augmentation split audits, legal-source verification and corpus regeneration were not independently rerun here.

Current OCR manifests isolate composition strings/rendered sources/layout conditions and distinguish known shared single-character diagnostics. This does not establish natural sign, unknown font or unrestricted OCR capability.
Voice speakers/sessions remain unknown; the manifest explicitly says no speaker-disjoint or manual-listening evidence. No unseen-speaker, ASR or open speech claim is supported.

General chat keyword rubrics remain mechanical frozen keyword matching. Their semantic field is not a human semantic judgment; normalized-exact, format and raw examples must be read separately and conservatively during Phase 6.

MoE/Dense relative accuracy, throughput, optimization stability and full-size resource bounds were not measured. Sampler balances task/intent buckets with replacement, not independently sampled source groups.

The new tiny_perceptron/selftrained/inference.py and scripts/selftrained/chat.py are outside this core report and require their separate independent safe-loader/public-history review before final publication.
